name: Purest Drive
author: Airwindows (Chris Johnson, MIT licence)
description: Airwindows PurestDrive by Chris Johnson: the cleanest saturation there is - it only drives what's loud and leaves the highs open. Ported from Airwindows (MIT licence).
code:
// Airwindows PurestDrive, Copyright (c) 2018 Chris Johnson, MIT licence (LICENSE-airwindows.txt) - ported to Central FX
@block
g = db2gain(output)
@sample
sL = sin(inL)
ap = (abs(pL + sL) / 2) * drive
pL = sin(inL)
outL = (inL * (1 - ap) + sL * ap) * g
sR = sin(inR)
ap = (abs(pR + sR) / 2) * drive
pR = sin(inR)
outR = (inR * (1 - ap) + sR * ap) * g
